title: 英伟达换帅反转：克雷斯临时掌舵，巴克哈斯被点名
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: This is a watershed moment, not just for Nvidia, it's a watershed moment for the AI ecosystem.
segments.zh: 这是一个转折点，不仅对英伟达，对整个AI生态系统也是如此。

segments.en: It's a watershed moment, frankly, to some extent, for the US economy, given the role that Huang played in helping to accelerate the build-out of AI that has added to US economic growth.
segments.zh: 坦率地说，某种程度上，这对美国经济也是一个转折点，鉴于黄仁勋在帮助加速AI建设方面所发挥的作用，这促进了美国经济增长。

segments.en: I don't think it's deep in the crisis. You have now the CFO, Colette Cress, who is at the helm, at least on an interim basis. You have Harvey Jones, who is the new board chair.
segments.zh: 我不认为这深陷危机。现在有首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯掌舵，至少是临时性的。还有哈维·琼斯，他是新的董事会主席。

segments.en: That's the role that we haven't had at Nvidia before, formerly at Synopsis.
segments.zh: 这是英伟达以前没有过的角色，之前在新思科技。

segments.en: He's been on the board for more than 25 years, and Colette Cress has been the CFO for 13 years.
segments.zh: 他在董事会任职超过25年，而科莱特·克雷斯担任首席财务官已有13年。

segments.en: I spoke to someone at Nvidia yesterday. They said that she is well-experienced, she knows the supply chain, she knows the partners, she knows Nvidia's customers,
segments.zh: 我昨天和英伟达的人谈过。他们说经验丰富，了解供应链，了解合作伙伴，了解英伟达的客户，

segments.en: she's seen internally as a safe pair of hands. The person I was speaking to said that they were still coming to terms with what's happened over the last few days,
segments.zh: 她内部被视为稳妥可靠的人选。与我交谈的人说，他们仍在消化过去几天发生的事情，

segments.en: and Nvidia saying that they were both shocked and angry by what they described as betrayal of Jensen Huang. But again, reassuring that Colette Cress is a safe pair of hands as the company now looks
segments.zh: 英伟达表示，他们对所描述的黄仁勋的背叛感到震惊和愤怒。但再次令人安心的是，科莱特·克雷斯是稳妥可靠的人选，因为公司现在正在考虑

segments.en: at who will take over a CEO on a longer-term basis. The internal favourite seems to be in Buck, who oversees the data centre, GPU and CUDA business. The external favourite, some have put,
segments.zh: 谁将长期接任CEO。内部热门人选似乎是负责数据中心、GPU和CUDA业务的巴克。外部热门人选，一些人提出，

segments.en: and some have named as René Hass. I understand through sources that René has the CEO of Arm cut short a trip to London yesterday to head back to California, though I do understand
segments.zh: 一些人点名了雷内·哈斯。我从消息源了解到，雷内昨天缩短了Arm CEO的伦敦之行，返回加州，不过我确实了解到
